# 2026-10-22 — full experimental pipeline (post-optimization round)

Wire-changing codec work landed: order ≤ 63 LPC, adaptive-gain stereo
modes (u3 mode + i8 gain), LTP pitch prediction (τ u12 + gain i8), LMS
two-tap adaptive last-mile pass (u2 step index), and partitioned
residuals with per-partition Rice / escape / adaptive-binary rANS coding
(6-bit param field). All changes are in the public v1 bitstream — this
doc records the reference numbers for that format.

Corpus: 47-file common subset of `sample_pack/` (accepted by every
compared tool). Encode at `-5`, verified decode (`--format wav`, data
chunks compared byte-exact) — 47/47 exact.

## Aggregate (% of source bytes)

| stage added | % of src |
|---|---|
| baseline (LPC ≤32, 4 stereo modes, Rice only) | 50.870% |
| + LPC order ≤63 | 50.820% |
| + adaptive-gain stereo | 50.809% |
| + LTP | 50.765% |
| + rANS partitions | 50.556% |
| + LMS pass | 50.265% |

Pairwise FLQ wins: FLAC 46/1 (median +1.08 pp), WavPack 35/12 (+1.26),
APE 25/22 (+0.05), TAK 9/38 (−0.50), OptimFROG 1/46 (−1.69).

## Speed cost (77 MB i16 WAV, single thread / 24 threads)

- encode `-5`: ~37 s / ~2.8 s wall (~10× / ~140× realtime) — ~32× slower
  than FLAC -8 single-threaded (1.33 s). The analysis chain (6 stereo
  signal plans, 11-order LPC proxy search, LTP scan, LMS probe, rANS
  quotient simulation) is the price of the extra −0.6 pp.
- decode: parallel frame decode ~2.4× wall speedup over sequential;
  output bytes identical regardless of `-j`.

Wire-neutral work in the same round (byte-identical verified): AVX2
autocorrelation (lane-per-lag keeps f64 summation order), chunk-granular
Rice prefix sums (9× less planner allocation), hoisted Tukey window,
rANS blob caching, preset probes for LMS step and rANS k.

Conformance vectors in `testdata/v1/` were regenerated for this format;
`v1_vectors_conform` re-encodes them byte-identically.
